text: 壹快评｜安徽GDP首超湖南：跳出位次之争看区域经济 相比一枝独秀，各美其美、协同共生，才是区域发展的更好状态。
text_en: Insight | Anhui's GDP overtakes Hunan for the first time: Look beyond the ranking tussle in regional economies — compared to a single standout, a better state of regional development is one where each shines in its own way while growing in coordination.
